## Original observations

```{r}
#| label: read-og-obs
# original observations
og_obs <- readRDS(here(
  L301_data_dir,
  "301b_ETF_EPT_IDS_api_uploads.rds"
)) |>
  # Read in iNat metadata
  left_join(
    read_rds(here(
      L1_data_dir,
      "101a_images_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.rds"
    )),
    join_by(observation_id == id)
  ) |>
  filter(batch_id == 0) # Test batch uploaded to iNat via API
```

```{r}
#| label: parse-og-obs
og_obs_base <- og_obs |>
  select(
    ## observation info
    observation_id,
    quality_grade,
    ### community taxon
    taxon_name = taxon.name,
    taxon_id = taxon.id,
    taxon_ancestry = taxon.min_species_ancestry,
    taxon_species_id = taxon.min_species_taxon_id,
    taxon_rank_level = taxon.rank_level,
    taxon_rank = taxon.rank,
    ### observer info
    observer_id = user.id,
    observer_login = user.login,
    observer_obs_cnt = user.observations_count,
    observer_ids_cnt = user.identifications_count,
    observer_spp_cnt = user.species_count,
    ### summary info (ids, com)
    identifications_count,
    num_identification_agreements,
    num_identification_disagreements,
    identification_disagreements_count,
    identifications_some_agree,
    comments_count,
    ### dataframes of ids, ann, com
    identifications,
    comments,
    annotations
  )
```

### Original subtables of identifications, annotations, comments

```{r}
#| label: og-obs-ids-table
og_obs_ids <- og_obs_base |>
  select(observation_id, identifications) |>
  unnest_longer(identifications) |>
  unpack(identifications, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(
    observation_id,
    identification_id = identifications_id,
    identifier_comment = identifications_body,
    identification_vision = identifications_vision,
    identification_own = identifications_own_observation,
    identifier_id = identifications_user.id,
    identifier_login = identifications_user.login,
    identification_taxon_id = identifications_taxon_id,
    identification_current = identifications_current,
    identification_created_at = identifications_created_at
  ) |>
  mutate(
    identification_occurrence = case_when(
      as.Date(identification_created_at) <= as.Date("2026-07-23") ~ "before",
      TRUE ~ "after"
    )
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: og-obs-ann-table
```

## Updated observations

```{r}
#| label: read-upd-obs
# updated observations
upd_obs <- readRDS(here(L3_data_dir, "302_updated_obs.rds")) |>
  rename(observation_id = id)
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-parse-json
safe_parse <- function(x) {
  map(
    x,
    ~ if (is.na(.x) || .x == "" || is.null(.x)) {
      list()
    } else {
      fromJSON(.x, simplifyDataFrame = TRUE)
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: parse-upd-obs
parsed_upd_obs <- upd_obs |>
  mutate(
    taxon = if (is.character(taxon)) safe_parse(taxon) else taxon,
    user = if (is.character(user)) safe_parse(user) else user,
    identifications = if (is.character(identifications)) {
      safe_parse(identifications)
    } else {
      identifications
    },
    comments = if (is.character(comments)) safe_parse(comments) else comments,
    annotations = if (is.character(annotations)) {
      safe_parse(annotations)
    } else {
      annotations
    }
  )


upd_obs_base <- parsed_upd_obs |>
  # taxon information
  hoist(
    taxon,
    taxon_name = "name",
    taxon_id = "id",
    taxon_ancestry = "min_species_ancestry",
    taxon_species_id = "min_species_taxon_id",
    taxon_rank_level = "rank_level",
    taxon_rank = "rank"
  ) |>
  # observer information
  hoist(
    user,
    observer_id = "id",
    observer_login = "login",
    observer_obs_cnt = "observations_count",
    observer_ids_cnt = "identifications_count",
    observer_spp_cnt = "species_count"
  ) |>
  select(
    ## observation info
    observation_id,
    quality_grade,
    ### community taxon
    starts_with("taxon_"),
    ### observer info
    starts_with("observer_"),
    ### summary info (ids, com)
    identifications_count,
    num_identification_agreements,
    num_identification_disagreements,
    identification_disagreements_count,
    identifications_some_agree,
    comments_count,
    ### dataframes of ids, ann, com
    identifications,
    comments,
    annotations
  )
```


### Updated subtables of identifications, annotations, comments

```{r}
#| label: FX-extract-user-fields
pull_user_field <- function(user_col, field = "id") {
  if (is.null(user_col)) {
    return(character(0))
  }
  if (is.data.frame(user_col)) {
    as.character(user_col[[field]] %||% NA_character_)
  } else if (is.list(user_col)) {
    map_chr(user_col, ~ as.character(.x[[field]] %||% NA_character_))
  } else {
    as.character(user_col)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-flatten-body-text
pull_clean_body <- function(body_col, n_rows) {
  if (is.null(body_col) || is.data.frame(body_col)) {
    rep(NA_character_, n_rows)
  } else if (is.list(body_col)) {
    map_chr(
      body_col,
      ~ if (length(.x) == 0 || is.null(.x)) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        as.character(.x[[1]])
      }
    )
  } else {
    as.character(body_col)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-guard-empty-elements
is_empty_entry <- function(x) {
  is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || (is.data.frame(x) && nrow(x) == 0)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: upd-obs-ids-table
upd_obs_ids <- flat_obs |> #upd_obs_base |>
  select(observation_id, identifications) |>
  mutate(
    identifications = map(identifications, function(df) {
      if (is_empty_entry(df)) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      # Force to df if not already
      df <- as_tibble(df)

      # Assemble desired columns
      tibble(
        identification_id = as.integer(df[["id"]]),
        identifier_comment = pull_clean_body(df[["body"]], nrow(df)),
        identification_vision = as.logical(df[["vision"]] %||% NA),
        identification_own = as.logical(df[["own_observation"]] %||% NA),
        identifier_id = as.integer(pull_user_field(df[["user"]], "id")),
        identifier_login = pull_user_field(df[["user"]], "login"),
        identification_taxon_id = as.integer(df[["taxon_id"]] %||% NA),
        identification_current = as.logical(df[["current"]] %||% NA),
        identification_created_at = as.character(df[["created_at"]] %||% NA)
      )
    })
  ) |>
  unnest(identifications) |>
  mutate(
    identification_occurrence = case_when(
      as.Date(identification_created_at) <= as.Date("2026-07-23") ~ "before",
      TRUE ~ "after"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: upd-obs-ann-table
upd_obs_ann <- flat_obs |> #upd_obs_base |>
  select(observation_id, annotations) |>
  mutate(
    annotations = map(annotations, function(df) {
      if (is_empty_entry(df)) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      # Force to df if not already
      df <- as_tibble(df)

      # Assemble desired columns
      tibble(
        annotation_uuid = as.character(df[["uuid"]] %||% NA),
        annotation_attr_id = as.integer(
          df[["controlled_attribute_id"]] %||% NA
        ),
        annotation_value_id = as.integer(df[["controlled_value_id"]] %||% NA),
        annotator_id = as.integer(pull_user_field(df[["user"]], "id")),
        annotator_login = pull_user_field(df[["user"]], "login")
      )
    })
  ) |>
  unnest(annotations)
```


```{r}
#| label: upd-obs-com-table
upd_obs_com <- flat_obs |> #upd_obs_base |>
  select(observation_id, comments) |>
  mutate(
    comments = map(comments, function(df) {
      if (is_empty_entry(df)) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      # Force to df if not already
      df <- as_tibble(df)

      # Assemble desired columns
      tibble(
        comment_id = as.integer(df[["id"]]),
        commenter_id = as.integer(pull_user_field(df[["user"]], "id")),
        comment_created_at = as.character(df[["created_at"]] %||% NA),
        comment_body = pull_clean_body(df[["body"]], nrow(df))
      )
    })
  ) |>
  unnest(comments) |>
  mutate(
    comment_occurrence = case_when(
      as.Date(comment_created_at) <= as.Date("2026-07-23") ~ "before",
      TRUE ~ "after"
    )
  )
```


# Explore data

script logic

* for original obs:
  * get info for IDs, comments, including user info
* for updated obs:
  * get info for IDs, comments, icnluding user info
* then join this info together by observation ID
* use craeted_at to distinguish between (before/after) adding my ID

for annotations, just compare # before and after because I can't check crated_at

explore chagen in taxonomic resolutoin


focus on the change in taxonomic level after I add my ID
that is, the consensus is still correct at the order-level!!!

```{r}
before <- og_obs_base |> count(taxon_rank)
after <- flat_obs |> count(taxon_rank)

before <- og_obs_base |>
  select(identifications_count, observation_id) |>
  mutate(
    observation_id = as.integer(observation_id),
    identifications_count = as.integer(identifications_count)
  )

after <- flat_obs |>
  select(identifications_count, observation_id) |>
  mutate(
    observation_id = as.integer(observation_id),
    identifications_count = as.integer(identifications_count)
  )

both <- full_join(
  before,
  after,
  by = "observation_id",
  suffix = c("_before", "_after")
) |>
  mutate(
    changed_obs = case_when(
      identifications_count_before != identifications_count_after ~ "changed",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(both, aes())

both |>
  filter(identifications_count_before != identifications_count_after) |>
  mutate(
    net_ids = identifications_count_after - identifications_count_before
  ) |>
  count(net_ids) |>
  mutate(
    highlight = if_else(
      net_ids > 1,
      "Catalyzed downstream IDs (> +1)",
      "Only your ID (+1)"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(net_ids), y = n, fill = highlight)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::comma(n)),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.8,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Only your ID (+1)" = "#4E79A7",
      "Catalyzed downstream IDs (> +1)" = "#E15759"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Net Identifications Gained",
    subtitle = "Observations that experienced changes between snapshots",
    x = "Net Identifications Added",
    y = "Number of Observations",
    fill = "Impact Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

both <- bind_rows(
  before = before,
  after = after,
  .id = "snapshot"
)

ggplot2::ggplot(both, aes(x = taxon_rank, y = n, fill = snapshot)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip()
```
